name: Agent Usage Plus
author: Gabriele Vigano
description: Live AI coding-subscription usage, limits, API-rate estimates, and token history in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: rate-limit meters with pace, today, the last week, and the all-time model breakdown for every subscription.

schema.label: Cycle interval (seconds)
schema.description: Only used when at least one provider is marked Cycle.

schema.label: Rotating bar slots
schema.description: How many providers rotate at once. Providers marked Fixed stay visible.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: Show available quota
schema.description: Show quota available instead of quota used in percentages, meters, threshold controls, and alerts.

schema.label: Color-code quota meters
schema.description: Use a green, amber, and red traffic-light palette for healthy, Warn, and Critical quota meters.

schema.label: Warn threshold (%)
schema.description: Usage percentage at which meters switch to the warn color.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: Usage percentage at which meters switch to the critical (urgent) color.

schema.label: Threshold notifications
schema.description: Notify once when a provider crosses Warn or Critical, not on every refresh.

schema.label: History window (days)
schema.description: Documents how much daily history a collector is expected to report in recentDays; the panel never fetches more than what's already in a record. See docs/collector-contract.md.
